degree: Higher education in Taiwan (specific degree levels are not itemised in the HTML programme page; they are listed in the annual Application Guidebook PDF)
official_source: Taiwan International Cooperation and Development Fund (TaiwanICDF)
program_type: Development-aid scholarship from an international cooperation fund
duration: Undergraduate up to 4 years, master's up to 2 years, Ph.D. up to 4 years (the maximum award period by degree level). 'You may not extend the duration of the scholarship. Any additional duration of study must be taken at your own expense.'

The Fund publishes the 2027 application round as 1 December 2026 to 15 March 2027 and requires every applicant to file through the TaiwanICDF Scholarship Online Application System. title: SEARCA Full Master's and PhD Scholarship Program

program_type: Regional graduate scholarship run by an intergovernmental research and training centre

title: ADB-Japan Scholarship Program (JSP)
official_source: Asian Development Bank (financed by the Government of Japan)
program_type: Multilateral scholarship financed by the Government of Japan and administered by the Asian Development Bank
description: The ADB-Japan Scholarship Program awards about 135 graduate scholarships a year for study in economics, business and management, science and technology and other development-related fields at 27 designated institutions in Asia and the Pacific, 17 of which are in Japan. The Japanese Government finances the programme and ADB administers it, including selecting awardees. Applicants apply directly to a designated institution, which screens and ranks them before ADB reviews the list and recommends awardees to the Executive Director of Japan for formal approval.

title: AICTE - Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Degree)
official_source: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Government of India
program_type: Government scholarship for women in technical education
duration: For every year of study: up to 4 years for first-year degree entrants and up to 3 years for degree entrants admitted through lateral entry
description: The Pragati Scholarship Scheme is implemented by the All India Council for Technical Education for girl students taking admission to AICTE-approved technical institutions at degree level. Each award is a lump sum of Rs 50,000 per year of study, given for up to four years for students admitted to the first year of a degree course and up to three years for degree students admitted through lateral entry. title: Undergraduate International Study Grants (Massey University)
funding: Tuition Fee Waiver (NZ$15,000 towards tuition fees)
description: Massey University's Undergraduate International Study Grants give new international students a NZ$15,000 contribution towards tuition fees for one year of full-time undergraduate study in a listed Bachelor's degree. Applicants are from any region but must be international students studying onshore in New Zealand. No separate application is made: the grant is assessed at the point of admission and appears on the offer of place if successful.

title: Postgraduate International Study Grants (Massey University)
funding: Tuition Fee Waiver (NZ$10,000 towards tuition fees)
description: Massey University's Postgraduate International Study Grants give new international students a NZ$10,000 contribution towards tuition fees for one year of full-time Master's study in a listed postgraduate degree. Applicants are from any region but must be international students studying onshore in New Zealand. No separate application is made: the grant is assessed at the point of admission and appears on the offer of place if successful.

title: Roberta Sykes Scholarship
degree: Doctoral Research, Postgraduate Coursework, Postgraduate Research
program_type: Charitable foundation scholarship (Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander postgraduate students, overseas study)
duration: Paid in equal instalments at the start of each semester or term, subject to academic progress
description: The Roberta Sykes Scholarship provides supplementary financial assistance to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander postgraduate students who wish to undertake full-time studies at any recognised overseas university. Roberta Sykes scholars must embody academic excellence and demonstrate a commitment to contributing to improving outcomes for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities.
